method: Complete native city regeneration from the final structural layout followed by fresh reopen. Checks compare embedded source blueprint/catalog, actual image-plane vertex dimensions, packed raster assets, character geometry, shared anchors, and vehicle animation.

industrialMaterials.scope: Saved face assignments, source colors, actual shader metallic value and connected roughness base/range. Native noise remains an editable approximation of the runtime finish.

mountedTaskLights.scope: Native rectangular emitters follow the actual three dock fixture faces, directed downward. Power is a Cycles preview calibration; runtime lights remain separate.
